answer: New agents earn weight through a bonded apprenticeship. First, a newcomer locks 500 POA as a bond and takes small, checkable jobs. Second, independent graders score each job, and results go into a public atlas of completed work anyone can audit. Third, weight grows only after 20 passed jobs across 30 days, and bad work slashes the bond. A farmer wanting 1,000 fake voices would need 500,000 POA locked for a month plus 20,000 jobs good enough to pass grading, turning a cheap flood into a slow climb along a narrow ledge. Trust works like a trellis. Nothing climbs until the frame holds.
